Ethereum ($ETH) just ran a test that could triple the network's capacity.

The Glamsterdam upgrade went live on Ethereum's Sepolia test network on Tuesday, lifting the block gas limit from 60 million to 200 million — blocks more than three times bigger. And it almost went wrong: developers rushed out a last-minute Prysm software update (version 7.2.1) the night before, because without it some validators would have kept making the old 60-million-gas blocks and watered down the whole test.

The test is really asking one question: can the computers running Ethereum handle blocks 3x larger without breaking? The answer decides how much room Ethereum's real network gets next. More room per block means more trades, more stablecoin transfers, more activity before users start competing for space and pushing fees up.

For now this is only a test network — Glamsterdam has no mainnet date yet. But if it holds up, Ethereum's biggest capacity jump in years moves one step closer to real.

If Ethereum could run at 3x capacity, how low do you think fees could actually go?

📰 Why is OpenAI testing ads in ChatGPT? The high-stakes question of how AI can make money

OpenAI is going to test ads in ChatGPT’s image generator, which means you might suddenly see brand ads while using AI to create images. That’s good news for OpenAI, which is looking to make money, but it could be a bit annoying for users who just want to use AI without ads. This move has the entire digital marketing industry wondering whether AI can become a cash cow.

Why does this news matter?
OpenAI is walking a tightrope: it needs to keep advancing its technology while also making money. AI companies used to be pretty patient and avoid running ads, but now OpenAI is putting ads right into one of the most popular AI apps. Why? Put simply, AI is so popular that it has to start making money. With BTC and ETH barely moving up day to day, everyone’s eager to make money—so why wouldn’t OpenAI be? What’s more, AI ads could be more precisely targeted than traditional ads: AI can track exactly what context users are in when they click.

Market impact
This news doesn’t have a direct impact on BTC and ETH, but what it could mean is important. If AI ads really become mainstream, they could draw some money away from traditional advertising. Whether that money will flow into crypto markets remains to be seen. Historically, the arrival of new technologies has always sparked a bout of market hype. But this time is different: AI is making real money, so there’s less room for speculation. Regulators will surely step in as AI ads take off. Whether AI applications will be under scrutiny everywhere in the future is still an open question.

Trading approach
💡 Neutral outlook, but this could give market sentiment a short-term boost. If ChatGPT users don’t mind the ads and brands are willing to pay for this kind of precise targeting, BTC and ETH could find support around $85K. But this view has a clear invalidation condition: if users widely reject AI ads, that support thesis no longer holds.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t an Admission of Defeat—it’s the Price of Admission to Your Next Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I’ve ever seen are quicker than anyone to admit when they’re wrong. Because they know that whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value across a hundred trades. The next time your hand hesitates as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

title: Kalshi’s 15-Minute Gold Market Just Surpassed Ethereum in Contracts — and Raked in Nearly $5 Million
subTitle: Kalshi’s ultra-short 15-minute gold prediction market has overtaken its own Ethereum market in total contract count, while platform fees approached $5 million in September, according to reports circulating among prediction-market observers.The milestone highlights surging retail demand for rapid-fire commodity contracts outside traditional crypto venues. Contract count measures the number of individual positions opened and settled, not notional volume or open interest. Because each 15-minute gold window resets dozens of times per session, the market generates far more discrete contracts than longer-duration Ethereum products, even if dollar volume lags.Fees near the $5 million mark (still an approximate, unverified figure) underscore the monetization power of high-frequency binary contracts. Platform take is deducted at each automatic settlement; with continuous resets, modest per-contract fees compound quickly across thousands of daily outcomes.These short-expiry gold contracts let traders bet solely on whether gold finishes the 15-minute interval higher or lower, with automatic settlement and no overnight risk. The rapid cadence, however, also means gains and losses can stack rapidly across sequential trades, a key consideration for retail participants.Analysts have previously flagged inconsistencies in Kalshi’s reported volume data, so both the contract-count crossover and the September fee figure should be viewed as preliminary until the platform issues fuller disclosures. Regulatory scrutiny is also rising, including warnings about licensing in certain jurisdictions. $ETH $XAU #Kalshi_News #ETH #XAU #StrategyMarketCapSurpassesRumble

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Position Compounding: Fortune Through Risk, or an Accelerator to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
The term “position compounding” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use several times leverage on a small amount of capital to ride a major trend, then compound it a few times
to multiply your capital dozens of times. Today, let’s talk about the part they don’t tell you.

【What Position Compounding Does】Unrealized gains aren’t cashed out; instead, they’re treated as risk capital for a new position and used to keep opening trades,
It's essentially borrowing from the market to leverage up. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, unrealized gains can go from
tens of points to zero in just one or two huge bearish candles.

【The Mathematical Truth】Position compounding is essentially about “being right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60%, the chance of winning four times in a row
is only 13%. Behind the overnight-doubling posts you see are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

The Glamsterdam testnet upgrade window has arrived | Mainnet launch date still undecided | ETH nears $2,600—I’m waiting for confirmation

My stance is to watch cautiously, not to treat the testnet schedule as a mainnet benefit already realized. The Ethereum Foundation’s Glamsterdam announcement set the planned Sepolia activation time at October 6, 13:53:36 UTC, corresponding to epoch 353024; the core developers’ deployment schedule lists the same time. That window has passed, but I have yet to see an official postmortem independently confirming the outcome and stability, so I can’t say the upgrade was fully successful, much less that mainnet has upgraded. The Foundation has made clear that dates for Hoodi and mainnet have not yet been set, and ordinary ETH holders do not need to take action because of the Sepolia announcement.

Why is this worth watching? Glamsterdam is intended to introduce protocol-level proposer-builder separation, block-level access lists, and changes to cost accounting, with the aim of improving L1 throughput and block building. The testnet can check client compatibility and validator participation, but that is still a long way from “more economic activity on mainnet and increased demand for ETH.” Next, we’ll need to watch for the Hoodi schedule, an official mainnet announcement, app adoption, fees, and ETH value capture; a roadmap cannot be translated into short-term buying pressure. If the test reveals client divergence or the schedule is delayed, the risks would instead increase.

The market has not priced in the plan as a standalone reason for a rally. At the time of writing, ETHUSDT on Binance was around $2,612, down about 3.36% over 24 hours, with a high of around $2,725 and a low of around $2,592; the drop cannot be attributed to the upgrade. In Farside’s current table, U.S. spot ETH ETFs recorded total net outflows of about $201.9 million on October 6, mostly shown under ETHA; the figures may be updated, and they do not prove where each spot sell order came from. The technical narrative and visible flows are not aligned, so I’d first want to see the price demonstrate support.

Key levels are the intraday low of $2,590, the $2,700 opening area, and the high of $2,725. If $2,590 fails to hold and there is no clear official disclosure that things are progressing smoothly, the short-term stabilization thesis is invalidated. Only if ETH moves back above $2,700 and holds on a retest, alongside positive testnet feedback and improving flows, would I consider a more bullish outlook. These price levels are conditions, not an inevitable reflection of the upgrade’s outcome.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase a rally now. I’d only consider a small spot long, with a maximum of 6% of my account capital allocated. The trigger would be a move back above $2,700, followed by a one-hour close and a retest that holds. Until then, I’d stay out and use no leverage. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,725 and exit the rest in stages at the second target of $2,780; the stop-loss would be below the retest low, with risk capped at 0.4% of the account on any single trade. If ETH breaks below $2,590, or the test produces clearly negative results, flows continue to weaken, and price fails to reclaim $2,700, I’d cancel the plan or close the position. If the trigger is not reached, there is no trade or profit.

Sources: Ethereum Foundation Glamsterdam testnet announcement https://blog.ethereum.org/2026/09/17/glamsterdam-testnet-announcement ; core developers’ deployment schedule https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/glamsterdam-pm.md ; Farside ETH ETF flows table https://farside.co.uk/ethereum-etf-flow-all-data/ . #ETH

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Position Sizing: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Getting Burned
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going in heavy right away and adding until you’re fully loaded with unrealized profits is a surefire way to land on the liquidation list.
A frequent occurrence. The right approach is called pyramid position sizing.

【The rule】Add less each time than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After confirming again, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be, keeping most of your cost basis low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, all your trades go off the rails.

No one knows how rough things were for Brother Ying back then. #ETH 

Burdened with debt and completely broke, I crouched on the toilet in a cramped, dimly lit rental room, my hand shaking uncontrollably.

The 4300U on the screen was the last of my capital—the money I’d scraped together by emptying my savings.

With no way out and no one to bail me out, I knew that if I lost it all, I’d leave crypto for good. At that moment, I gritted my teeth and went all in.

I spent that whole period lying awake all night, consumed by fear and anxiety.

For three whole years, I stubbornly turned that desperate last bit of capital into a seven-figure account. Countless times, I was tempted by trending coins; countless times, I wanted to take profits early and run. Every time, I forced myself to suppress my impatience.

I had no talent and no inside information. I built a solid footing with nothing but a clumsy, rigid set of trading rules.

Over the years, I’ve seen all sides of human nature, and a whole new batch of so-called smart people has come and gone in crypto.

Everyone wants to switch coins constantly and catch explosive rallies. In the end, most lose money and leave. Meanwhile, people like me, who don’t chase huge profits and stick to the rules, survive—and see our accounts grow steadily.

Brother Shen and a few longtime friends have followed four hard-and-fast rules for years. They’re simple, but they can keep you in the game.

First, follow the trend and the flow of funds. Only keep coins that have been strong over the past ten days. Drop any coin that falls for three consecutive days. Never fight the market’s money flow. $牛来 

Second, use the monthly chart to set the direction. If the monthly MACD hasn’t produced a bullish golden cross, stay firmly in cash. Better to miss out than settle for less.

Third, stick to your entry points. Only buy on a pullback to the 60-day moving average when a high-volume bullish candle or a long lower wick appears. Don’t chase a move without volume.

Fourth, the 60-day moving average is the line between life and death. Take profits in stages after gains of 30% and 50%. If the closing price falls below the moving average, exit completely, no exceptions.

Use the monthly chart to determine the trend and the daily chart to protect your principal. Risk management always comes before profits. This approach isn’t exciting or flashy, and it offers no overnight-riches myth—but it’s the safest way for ordinary people to make it through.

In crypto, what matters in the end has never been brains. It’s self-discipline.

The market action today is honestly pretty ugly.
Altcoins are almost all in the red, and $UNI  couldn't hold up either, dropping straight from around $9 to roughly $7.9—a decline of nearly 8%.

To be honest, it's perfectly normal for people who got UNI around $6 earlier to give back some of their gains now.
After such a big rally, when the broader market sells off like this, it's normal for people to take profits.

But what I'm more focused on now isn't how much it fell today.
It's this: is this move attacking the fundamentals, or is it simply shaking out profit-takers?
At the moment, I lean toward the latter.

That's because the things that were supposed to happen with $UNI  haven't disappeared just because prices fell today.
The protocol fee mechanism is still there, the UNI burn thesis is still there, and developments in areas like onchain stocks and institutional DeFi are still underway.
CME is even planning to launch UNI futures on October 19, though they're currently awaiting regulatory review.
So when I see a drop like today's, I won't look at one big red candle and immediately declare UNI finished.
Instead, I'll start watching one level: around $7.5.

If the market stays fearful and pushes UNI down to that area, I'll seriously consider buying some spot in batches.
I'll stay away from futures for now.
When the whole market is selling off together, one of the easiest mistakes to make is trying to win back your losses with leverage.
I'd rather take it slow.
After all, if you truly believe in an asset, you should be able to face its pullbacks, not just its rallies.
And don't forget, UNI's thesis today is no longer just that of a governance token.
It's a strong application, protocol revenue, fee capture, and the broader narrative around onchain assets all rolled into one.

None of that is going to disappear in a single day just because the price fell 8%.
So, if anything, I'm actually feeling a little excited.
If the market keeps selling off and $UNI  reaches around $7.5, I'll keep adding to my position.
Because what really makes people FOMO isn't the drop.
It's hesitating and not buying, then watching it suddenly surge from the $7 range back to $9 or $10 a few days later.
By then, trying to pick up cheap tokens might not feel so easy.

title: 🔄 DCA Bot & Martingala: Cómo optimizar tu precio medio de entrada sin comprometer tu capital
subTitle:
Comprar en el pico local o intentar adivinar el piso exacto de un activo es uno de los errores más comunes en el trading. Al entrar con el 100% del capital en una sola orden (Lump Sum), la posición queda inmediatamente expuesta a cualquier retroceso del mercado.

El DCA Bot (Dollar-Cost Averaging / Martingala) de Binance automatiza la ejecución de compras escalonadas a medida que el precio cae, reduciendo dinámicamente el precio medio de entrada para acelerar la salida en ganancia con un rebote menor.

1. La Mecánica del Promediado Inteligente

A diferencia de las compras aleatorias:

Orden de Base y Órdenes de Seguridad: El bot abre una posición inicial (Orden Base) y coloca órdenes adicionales (Órdenes de Seguridad) a intervalos porcentuales predefinidos si el precio sigue descendiendo.

Escalamiento de Posición (Multiplicador de Volumen): Permite aumentar progresivamente el tamaño de cada compra posterior, logrando que el precio medio de entrada se acerque mucho más rápido al precio actual del activo.

2. Compra Directa vs. DCA Bot

Compra Directa (Lump Sum): Requiere un movimiento alcista completo de regreso al precio original para recuperar el breakeven o generar ganancias.

DCA Bot: Al bajar constantemente el precio promedio, requiere solo un pequeño porcentaje de rebote desde el fondo local para cerrar la posición entera con el objetivo de beneficio deseado (Take Profit).

3. Consejo Táctico Express (Control del Multiplicador de Escalón)

💡 El "Tip" de DCA: Al configurar tu DCA Bot, mantén un Multiplicador de Volumen entre 1.2x y 1.5x y limita las Órdenes de Seguridad a máximo 4 o 5 niveles. Utilizar multiplicadores extremos (ej. 2.0x estilo Martingala agresiva) agota rápidamente tu margen disponible y puede exponer la cuenta a un drawdown insostenible si la tendencia bajista se prolonga.

👉 ¿Sueles promediar entradas manualmente durante las caídas o utilizas un DCA Bot para automatizar la gestión? ¡Déjame tu experiencia en los comentarios!

Si este análisis cuantitativo te ayuda a optimizar tus estrategias automatizadas en Binance, sígueme para continuar descubriendo más herramientas tácticas.

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you'll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners just tap one at random and end up taking a big loss.

[Cross margin] Your entire account balance is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in an extreme market, your losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one
They all back each other up in the same basket.

[Isolated margin] Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If this position is liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

[My recommendation] Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you can't yet assess the worst-case scenario of “one bad trade”

【Stop Lying to Yourself—ETH’s “Small Dip” Is the Biggest Trap】

A lot of people think ETH is only down 5%, which seems gentle compared with altcoins that have been cut in half. They get the false impression that their positions are safe. I’ve seen far too many people get burned by the logic that “a smaller drop means less risk.” The reality is this: ETH’s volatility has never been about percentages—it hits you in absolute terms.

The daily chart structure has already broken down. I’ve been watching the 2777 resistance level for a long time, and now the price is hovering below it. Every rebound comes on shrinking volume, which shows the bulls simply don’t have the strength to reclaim lost ground. 2515 is the critical level below. If it breaks decisively, then it’s no longer about technical analysis—it’s about who can get out fastest. The 4-hour chart looks even worse: the candlesticks are arranged in a textbook bearish pattern, with the moving averages pressing down from above.

There’s a signal in the volume: it’s rising as the price falls, and that’s not a good sign. It means someone is dumping—not small retail traders selling off a little at a time, but selling pressure on a much larger scale. The ETF data makes the picture even clearer: ETH funds have seen net outflows for six straight days, totaling more than $400 million, while BTC funds have had net inflows of $119 million. Institutions are voting with their feet. Their stance is pretty clear, isn’t it?

BitMine’s 5% supply cap sounds like a moat, but look at it another way: they’ve drawn a line for themselves—once they’re over 5%, they stop buying. It’s a pretty generous limit, but the message is clear: “I’ll only hold this much. Don’t expect me to be the one catching the falling knife.”

So what does this mean in practice? Institutions are pulling out, retail investors are holding on, and ETF funds are continuing to bleed. In this kind of market, those of you still holding ETH need to be ready for a long haul.

How am I feeling right now? Sure, I’m tempted to jump in, but that 2017 crash still hurts. There’s no way I’m reaching in at this level. What about you—would you buy this dip? Are you still comfortable with your position?

很多人觉得ETH才跌5%，比那些山寨动辄腰斩温柔多了，错觉自己仓位安全。我见过太多人被这种"跌幅小=风险小"的逻辑坑死。真实情况是——ETH的波动从来不是按比例算的，是按绝对值砸的。

日线结构已经破位。2777这个阻力位我盯了很久，现在价格在这里下方晃悠，每次反弹都缩量，说明多头根本没力气收复失地。下方2515是命门，这个位置要是有效跌破，那接下来就不是技术分析了，是看谁跑得快。4小时级别更难看，K线排列完全是空头炮形态，均线系统从上往下压。

所以这事落到实处意味着什么？机构在撤，散户在扛，ETF资金持续失血。这种格局下，还拿着ETH的兄弟，得做好持久战准备。

📰 Why did the market barely react when Paxos launched $3B USDG on Arbitrum?

Paxos announced that its USD-pegged stablecoin, USDG, had officially launched on Arbitrum, with plans to use $100 million in ARB rewards to incentivize token adoption and liquidity. But honestly, when the news broke, almost nobody in the crypto market paid attention, with everyone focused instead on BTC and ETH falling.

Why does this news matter?
As a leader in regulated stablecoins, Paxos chose Arbitrum, a popular L2 platform—a move that, in theory, should have sparked a surge in liquidity. Yet the market remained unmoved. There are several deeper reasons behind this. First, the stablecoin market is currently a battle for existing market share, with capital flowing mainly into dollar-backed stablecoins such as USDC and USDT. New stablecoins are unlikely to gain significant market share in the short term. Second, Arbitrum is already crowded, and adding another stablecoin could worsen network congestion. Third, regulatory pressure remains a sword of Damocles hanging over stablecoins. Although Paxos is compliant, the entire industry is waiting for a clear position from the U.S. SEC. The importance of this news lies in how it reflects the lack of real demand for stablecoin innovation in the crypto market, rather than the optimism suggested on the surface.

Market impact
In the short term, USDG’s launch on Paxos will have minimal impact on BTC and ETH, as market sentiment is already dominated by bearish conditions. In the medium to long term, however, if L2 platforms continue to gain regulatory recognition (for example, if the U.S. approves an L2 ETF in the future), competition among compliant stablecoins on L2s could intensify, benefiting the L2 ecosystem. A similar historical example is Circle issuing USDC on Solana. The launch initially received little market attention, but USDC gradually became an important part of Solana’s liquidity.

Trading approach
This news suggests that stablecoin innovation is shifting from a purely technological competition toward a combined focus on compliance and real-world use cases. If the regulatory environment becomes clearer, compliant stablecoins on L2s may outperform ordinary DeFi tokens. For now, however, Paxos’s $300 million in seed funding will most likely be absorbed within Arbitrum’s own ecosystem and is unlikely to shake up the broader market. This outlook would be invalidated if new regulatory crackdowns emerge in the near term or BTC falls below $83,411.84.

📰 为什么 Paxos 在 Arbitrum 上推出 $3B USDG 时，市场却毫无反应？

Paxos 宣布其美元稳定币 USDG 在 Arbitrum 链上正式上线，并计划通过 1 亿美元 ARB 奖励激励代币和流动性。但说实话，这条新闻公布时，整个加密市场除了关注 BTC 和 ETH 的跌势，几乎没人注意到这个消息。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Paxos 作为合规稳定币的领头羊，选择 Arbitrum 这个热门 L2 平台，理论上应该引爆流动性。但市场无动于衷，背后有几点深层原因。第一，目前稳定币市场整体处于存量博弈，资金主要流向美元存款产品（如 USDC、USDT），新稳定币很难在短期内抢占份额。第二，Arbitrum 上已拥挤不堪，新增一个稳定币对可能加剧链上拥堵问题。第三，监管压力始终是悬在稳定币头上的达摩克利斯之剑，Paxos 虽然合规，但整个行业都在等待美国 SEC 的明确表态。这条新闻之所以重要，在于它反映了加密市场对稳定币创新的实际需求不足，而非表面上的乐观预期。

对市场的影响
短期来看，Paxos 上线 USDG 对 BTC 和 ETH 的影响微乎其微，因为市场情绪已被熊市主导。但中长期看，如果 L2 平台持续被监管机构认可（比如未来美国批准 L2 ETF），这类合规稳定币的 L2 竞争可能加剧，利好 L2 生态。历史类似事件有 Circle 在 Solana 上发行 USDC，初期也未被市场过度关注，但后来逐渐成为 Solana 流动性的重要组成部分。

操作思路
这条新闻意味着稳定币创新正在从纯粹的技术竞赛转向合规与场景落地并重。如果未来监管环境明确，这类合规稳定币在 L2 上的表现可能会优于普通 DeFi 代币。但眼下，Paxos 3 亿美元的启动资金，大概率只能消化在 Arbitrum 的内部生态，难以撼动整体市场格局。如果短期内出现新的监管打压或 BTC 跌破 $83,411.84，这个判断就作废。

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

zkAPI separates payments from identity | Mainnet tool is live, not a protocol upgrade | Don’t chase ETH at 2,580

My view is that the application is promising, but I’ll remain cautious about trading. On October 1, the Ethereum Foundation introduced zkAPI: users first deposit usage credits into a vault on Ethereum, then use zero-knowledge proofs to request API access credentials with time limits and spending caps. Service providers can confirm that a user has sufficient credits without learning from payment records which deposit was used; the party providing the AI model can still see the request contents. The Foundation says zkAPI is live on mainnet as a tool, and its official code repository has published the client, server, and contracts. Here, “live” means the application contracts have been deployed—not that Ethereum has completed another underlying protocol upgrade, and certainly not that privacy features now cover all ETH transfers.

What matters to me is whether this payment flow can bring real usage to the blockchain—not whether the words “AI + privacy” can be translated directly into an ETH rally. The current model bundles multiple API calls into a single authorized session, avoiding the need to settle each request individually on-chain. That improves the user experience, but it also means that a single use may not generate a mainnet transaction. The vault can be denominated in different assets, so it would be wrong to call all deposits new buying demand for ETH. The project documentation also notes that an anonymous payment flow does not make users anonymous on the network: providers can still see prompts, while IP addresses, timing correlations, and content characteristics may reveal identities. A proxy relay setup also lets the relay server see requests. To assess the actual economic impact going forward, we should look at real users, deposited balances, contract interactions, and fees—not just the launch narrative.

The market is not currently pricing this tool on its own as a bullish catalyst. At the time of writing, Binance ETH/USDT was around 2,580, down about 4.8% over 24 hours, with an intraday high of 2,725.13 and a low of 2,565.01. Of course, the decline cannot be attributed to zkAPI either. Farside previously showed that U.S. spot ETH funds saw net outflows of about $202 million on October 6—this is a separate capital-flow backdrop, not a measure of zkAPI usage. For the short term, my key levels are whether the low near 2,565 holds, whether ETH can reclaim 2,600, and whether 2,650 can attract further buying. If ETH breaks below 2,565 and still fails to reclaim it on a rebound, no application innovation can replace a price-based stop-loss. If it regains and holds above 2,650 while outflows ease, I would consider shifting from a defensive stance to cautiously probing a trade.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and avoid leverage. I would only consider a conditional spot long: two consecutive 15-minute candles must close above 2,600, followed by a retest that holds 2,600 without contracting volume. Only then would I enter with 0.4% of my total capital. My first target would be 2,650, where I would sell half; I would let the rest run toward 2,700. I would place the stop below 2,575, with account risk on the trade capped at 0.15%. If ETH still cannot hold 2,600 after two hours, or if it breaks below 2,565 first, I would close the position or cancel the plan. I would also abandon the long thesis immediately if the project issued an official security notice. If none of these conditions are met, I would remain flat; a plan must not be presented as an executed trade or a profit.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度是认可应用方向、交易上继续谨慎。以太坊基金会10月1日介绍zkAPI：用户先向以太坊上的金库存入使用额度，再用零知识证明申请有时限、有金额上限的API访问凭证。服务方能确认额度足够，却不必从支付记录得知是哪一笔存款；提供AI模型的一方仍然会看到请求内容。基金会说它已作为工具在主网上运行，官方代码仓库也公开了客户端、服务端和合约。这里的“运行”是应用合约部署，不是以太坊完成新一轮底层协议升级，更不是隐私功能已经覆盖所有ETH转账。

我关心的核心是付费路径能否给链上带来真实使用，而不是把“AI+隐私”四个字直接折算成ETH上涨。现有模式把多次API调用放进一次授权会话，避免每条请求都在链上单独结算；这改善体验，却意味着单次使用未必产生一笔主网交易。金库可以使用不同资产计价，不能把所有存款都说成新增ETH买盘。项目文档也写明，支付链路匿名不等于网络匿名：供应商仍可看到提示词，IP地址、时间关联和内容特征可能泄露身份；代理中转模式还会让中转服务器看到请求。若后续要评估实际经济效应，应看真实用户、存入余额、合约交互和手续费，而不是只看发布会叙事。

Guys, there’s a kind of loss that really hurts.

You’ve made a decent profit, only to watch it slowly slip away. I used to make this mistake all the time when trading in a rising market near the highs. As prices climbed, my account kept turning greener, and it was easy to fall for the same illusion: as long as prices are still going up, the trend must be fine. But I later realized that price isn’t the only thing worth watching near the highs. For example, after a rally, trading volume suddenly surges, but the price barely moves higher. The candlestick chart looks lively—prices surge and plunge, break out only to pull back, or drop only to get pulled back up. At times like these, I don’t simply interpret it as strength anymore. When volume rises but prices can’t push higher, it means disagreement in the market is clearly growing. Some people are still chasing the rally, while others are starting to take profits. We need to keep watching to see who comes out on top next.#zec 

There’s another situation that’s even more deceptive. Prices keep setting new highs, and the mood in the group gets more and more excited, but the rally is clearly slowing down. A move that used to happen in a single candlestick now takes several attempts just to break through. That’s when people are most likely to say, “I’ll sell after it goes up just a little more.” Often, they never get that little bit more. So now, when I encounter a market near the highs, I don’t try to guess whether it’s at the top. Instead, I look at whether it can keep moving higher with the same strength. If price, volume, and market structure don’t line up, I’d rather take some profits off the table first.

Nobody can calculate the exact top in advance. But when something starts to feel off in the market, it usually leaves clues. Good traders may not be able to sell at the very top, but they know when to rein in their greed.@Square-Creator-58b326784 #ETH

title: 为什么我不建议你在以太坊2560抢反弹？
subTitle:
以太坊今天从2700高位一路砸到2560。
一路阴跌，目前没有一点止跌的迹象。
前几天我一直看空、喊空、开空，不知道你有没有跟上。
现在很多人最抓狂的问题是，跌了这么多，到底能不能进场抄底？还是说借着微弱的反抽继续追空？
我的看法很简单，这波往上的反抽就是个套，到了阻力区必须毫不犹豫地往下砸，因为底下的买盘极度虚胖。
说到这种虚胖的套路，让我想起了昨晚的一局牌。
松行长提议，打两圈掼蛋。 我跟红裤子一伙。 松行长和我哥一伙。
我问我哥，你们搞的那个佛音疗愈小镇，装修会议室的钱到底谁出？
我哥叹了口气，说现在看的话，需要咱自己掏钱了。
其实最初，我哥的算盘打得挺精。 他的想法是不见兔子不撒鹰，合作的前提是让法师先帮着卖几套房子，回笼点资金再说。
前几天法师那边的信徒从浙江跑来认真谈了谈，我哥直接就虚了。
人家不仅不卖房子了，还要把整个社区定位成主题小镇，连已经卖出去的都要租回来当基地。
我哥一听，觉得人家是真有实力，现在要是再提条件，就显得自己不知好歹了。
我问他，那他们不投钱？ 他说对方提议合伙成立公司，法师那边拿大头，我哥拿小头，然后公司再跟社区签租赁协议。
基于这个虚无缥缈的框架，我哥就觉得这十几万的音响设备钱应该自己出。
我说我书店那套搬去就行，单晶铜的导线一米五百多块，结果我哥嫌不合格，觉得配不上人家。
这不就是典型的被人推着往前走，稀里糊涂替别人垫资吗？ 我说，别折腾了一圈，人家拍拍屁股走了，你买的那些喇叭音响连收破烂的都不要。
我哥还挺乐呵，觉得法师不会骗人，毕竟人家许诺一年能流水培训一万人，按两万一人算就是两个亿的盘子。
其实这些宗教选手，虽然喜怒无常，但他们手底下的脑残粉是真的脑残。
我哥之前就尝过甜头，前期手里一半的房子都是本土道士卖给信徒的。
只要你会舔，让他感受到你的忠诚，他就愿意为你使用他的影响力。
但是这次，局势反过来了。 以前是我哥利用道士，现在是法师利用我哥的贪念，让他来垫资试错。 这让我想起以前招商口遇到的那个南方来的混子。
连名字和身份证都是假的，说要来投资，招商口的领导都陪着打球，大学的教授跟着背书。
结果呢，钱骗了一圈，人彻底消失了。
红裤子的同学更是惨，在招商饭局上认识的，觉得有官方层层背书，十万块钱存款全借出去了。
松行长也说，他有个前员工突然高调得离谱，说在新疆开矿，感觉有100个亿，结果还跑来要别人拿几十万入股。
真有100个亿，咋可能要你那几十万呢？扶贫也轮不到你。
一个人出门在外，身份都是自己给的，只要层层背书搞得好，总有傻子愿意掏真金白银。
不管听起来多宏大的项目，只要最后是让你先垫钱、让你去承担风险，那基本就是个杀猪局。
这两天的ETH盘面上，全是被宏大叙事忽悠进去垫资的冤大头。 从2800一路狂泄砸下来，底下的防线直接被断头铡刀式斩断。
现在价格砸到了2560附近，下方确实爆出了近期最大的成交量。#ETH 
很多人一看底下放了天量，觉得大资金在托底，赶紧冲进去抢反弹。 这就跟我哥看到法师画的两个亿大饼一样，光看着未来的利润，根本没去算眼下的风险。 这根带长下影线的暴跌，确实说明有人在底下接盘，但这绝对不代表马上就要拉升。主力的资金也是要成本的，底下的筹码如果够了，早就直接拉飞了，还会停在这里给你机会进场抢筹？ 这就好比法师搞了个动静很大的音乐会热场子，看着很热闹，其实是在试探还有多少人愿意掏钱买单。 现在的微弱反弹，就是主力给你画的那个图纸。 价格往上抽一抽，到了2610到2630这个盘整点，也是套牢盘最密集的地方。

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100U control 1,000U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you earn 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage is when the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U of your own money and use 10x leverage, you’re actually controlling a position worth 1,000U.
If the coin price rises 1%, you earn 10% on your principal; conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—注意, the loss is calculated based on the total position you borrowed to control.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the coin price moves against you by about 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that the price has to drop 10% for you to lose everything; a drop of about 10% is enough to wipe it all out (the exact level also depends on the maintenance margin).

正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math Behind Going All-In—Will You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% when it wins and losing 50% when it loses. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in each time, here’s the long-term expected return: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = +10% per trade,
which looks like a positive expectancy. But consider the path: two losses in a row mean a 75% loss, and you’d need a 300% gain to break even.
A positive-expectancy strategy + going all-in = a high probability of bankruptcy. This is the gambler’s ruin theorem playing out every day in crypto.
day after day.

The same strategy, but only putting 20% of your capital at risk each time: two losses in a row means -18%, hardly devastating,
while you still capture the long-term expected return. The strategy hasn’t changed—only the position size has, and that makes all the difference between survival and ruin.

The Bank of Russia has registered nine organizations under the country’s new cryptocurrency framework, including four crypto exchange operators and five digital custodians. The move creates Russia’s first officially regulated infrastructure for buying, selling and holding digital assets.

Major state-owned banks are among the approved participants. Sberbank and VTB have been registered as digital custodians, while VTB is also authorized as a crypto exchange operator. Sberbank says it plans to launch its first crypto products on December 1, initially supporting Bitcoin, Ether and USDT.

The framework took effect on September 1, 2026, putting crypto trading and custody under Bank of Russia oversight. Crypto transactions will have to go through licensed intermediaries, while the country’s ban on using cryptocurrency for ordinary payments remains in place.

The development marks a significant shift in Russia’s approach to digital assets. Rather than leaving crypto activity largely outside the traditional financial system, Moscow is now building a state-regulated market involving major banks and licensed intermediaries.

📰 Solana CEO Joseph Chee: Why Is China Using Hong Kong to Test Crypto Systems?

Solana CEO Joseph Chee said on Tuesday that China is closely monitoring cryptocurrencies and blockchain technology, but remains concerned that ordinary people could be exploited by them. He believes China is using Hong Kong as a testing ground for crypto systems and argues that education should be strengthened before they are widely adopted. This account comes from a report by Binance Square.

Why does this news matter?
As the world’s largest cryptocurrency regulatory market, China’s changing stance is a bellwether for the industry. Chee noted that China is conducting real-world tests, rather than limiting itself to theoretical research. This suggests that although China remains cautious, it has not entirely ruled out the potential of crypto technology. Hong Kong’s unique status makes it an ideal place for regulatory experimentation: it has a free financial environment while maintaining close ties with mainland China.

Market impact
This may have no direct short-term impact on sentiment toward BTC/ETH, but in the long term, the subtle shifts in China’s regulatory stance are worth watching. If the Hong Kong tests yield positive results with a focus on risk control, they could serve as a model for other regions; otherwise, they could reinforce expectations of tighter regulation worldwide. Historically, similar regulatory experiments—such as Japan’s licensing of cryptocurrency exchanges—have ultimately had a profound impact on the market landscape.

Trading outlook
💡 This suggests that China may be gathering data in preparation for a possible compliance framework in the future. BTC is currently near $83,594; if it holds this level, that would suggest the market is handling regulatory uncertainty relatively well. But if it falls below $80,000, the positive significance of China’s testing approach would be diminished. This assessment would no longer hold if U.S. employment data released tonight comes in significantly below expectations.

Solana 公司 CEO Joseph Chee 在周二表示，中国正密切监控加密货币和区块链技术，但依然担心普通人被其利用。他认为中国把香港当作加密系统的试验田，并主张在全面推广前先加强教育。这一说法来自 Binance Square 的报道。

为什么这条新闻重要？
中国作为全球最大的加密货币监管市场，其态度变化对行业具有风向标意义。Chee 指出中国正进行实际测试，而非仅停留在理论研究阶段。这表明中国虽然保持警惕，但并未完全排除加密技术的可能性。香港的特殊地位使其成为监管实验的理想场所——这里既有自由金融环境，又能与中国内地紧密联动。

对市场的影响
对 BTC/ETH 短期情绪可能无直接冲击，但长期看，中国监管态度的微妙转变值得市场关注。如果香港测试结果积极且注重风险控制，可能为其他地区提供参考；反之则可能强化全球监管趋严的预期。历史上，类似监管实验的案例如日本的加密货币交易所牌照发放，最终对市场格局产生深远影响。

title: PATIENCE IS NOT DOING NOTHING.
subTitle:
In crypto, it's easy to feel that you must always be doing something. Buy something. Sell something. Find the next coin. Follow the next trend. Catch the next opportunity. But sometimes the smartest decision is simply: WAIT. Waiting can give you time to:
🔍 Do more research.
🧠 Understand the risk.
📊 Watch how the market behaves.
💰 Protect your capital.
📝 Review your plan.
😌 Let emotions settle.
HERE'S THE IMPORTANT PART: You don't lose an opportunity simply because you didn't take it immediately. The market will continue producing new opportunities. You don't have to catch them all.
🧠 REMEMBER: Impatience asks: “How quickly can I make something?” Discipline asks: “Is this actually a good decision?” Those are very different questions. If you are still learning, there is nothing wrong with saying: “I don't know yet. I'll keep learning.” That can be a very powerful decision.
💬 When the market becomes exciting, what helps you stay patient?
A. Research
B. Having a written plan
C. Limiting how often I check the market
D. Remembering my risk
E. I'm still learning
👇 Share your answer. Let's learn together one decision at a time.

It does not mean that an exchange open to everyone is now operating, much less that the central bank has approved an ETH product. I also checked the central bank’s latest registration page and confirmed that these registration categories exist. However, the announcement does not say when each institution will actually begin operating, which coins it will support, or how much trading volume it will generate.

Why should ETH traders pay attention to this news? Discussions about institutional adoption have often lumped together “legal access,” “product listings,” and “actual capital inflows.” In reality, the sequence should be: first, compliant entities; then operating rules and custody capabilities; and only then potentially verifiable trades and holdings. If ETH is added to the list of assets that compliant institutions can trade or custody, marginal liquidity could improve. But that is a conditional scenario, not evidence that ETH buying has already taken place. Rather than speculate, I care more about whether subsequent official lists, product terms, and on-chain or financial disclosures corroborate one another.

The market has not confirmed this narrative with a rally either. At the time of writing, ETHUSDT on Binance was around $2,578, down about 4.99% over 24 hours, with a high of 2,725 and a low of 2,565. The daily decline cannot be attributed to the Russian announcement; if anything, the price suggests risk appetite remains weak. My reference levels are the intraday low near 2,565, the psychological 2,600 level, and resistance above 2,650. These are reference points for an execution plan, not a promise that the price will rebound. If 2,565 breaks and the rebound attempt is weak, the compliance news is not enough to overturn the short-term weakness. If the price gets back above 2,600 and trading volume confirms the move, I’ll reassess the potential for a rebound.

If I were trading this myself: I would stay out for now. I would only consider a small spot long position, with no leverage. I would first wait for two consecutive 15-minute candles to close above 2,600, then wait for a pullback to 2,590–2,600 to hold before entering. I would use no more than 0.25% of my total capital. If triggered, I would sell half near 2,635 and close the rest near 2,680. If the price closes back below 2,575 after entry, I would proactively reduce my position; below 2,560, I would stop out completely. If the price shoots straight through the targets without a pullback, I’d rather miss the move. If the Russian central bank tightens the rules further, ETH is not included in the relevant business activities, or the price breaks below the planned low, I would immediately abandon this long idea. Focus on business activity that actually comes online; don’t treat a list of approved institutions as a guarantee of profit.

这条消息为什么值得ETH交易者看？过去讨论机构采用，常把“合法路径”“产品上架”和“真实资金流入”混成一件事。实际上顺序应是先有合规主体，再有运营规则和托管能力，最后才可能出现可核验的成交与持仓。ETH若进入合规机构的可交易或可托管清单，边际流动性可能改善；但这是条件推演，不是已发生的ETH买盘。比起猜测，我更看重后续官方名单、产品条款及链上或财务披露能否彼此印证。

市场目前也没有用上涨确认这一叙事。写稿时币安ETHUSDT约2578美元，24小时约跌4.99%，区间高点2725、低点2565。单日下跌不能归因于俄罗斯公告，价格反而提示风险偏好仍弱。我的观察线是2565附近的日内低点、2600整数位和2650上方压力；它们是执行计划的参考，不是价格必然反弹的承诺。若2565失守后反抽无力，所谓合规利好不足以推翻短线弱势；若重新站回2600并出现成交跟随，再评估反弹空间。

There’s a kind of loss in trading that’s especially easy to overlook.

Every day, you scroll through charts, read articles, study indicators, and your bookmarks keep piling up. Someone talks about breakouts, so you study breakouts; someone talks about trends, so you study trends; someone makes money with short-term trading, and you start thinking about short-term trading too. But when you look back at your own trade history, it’s still the same mistakes: chasing entries, failing to hold on, trying to ride out losses, and taking profits too early.

Later, I went back through my own history and noticed something interesting.
The trades that really cost me were the ones I thought I’d already figured out. Because I thought I understood them, I was willing to take bigger positions; because I’d been right a few times before, I was willing to bet early this time too.
The more you learn, the bolder you can sometimes become. Eventually, I started doing the opposite. When I came across a new method, I didn’t rush to try it with real money. I put it on a watchlist first and observed it over dozens of occurrences to see whether I could actually understand it. If I couldn’t understand it, I left it alone. If I couldn’t clearly explain why I was entering, I left it alone. If I had to scramble for an indicator to give me courage, I left it alone too. After that, I actually seemed less like a professional than before. I stopped discussing with everyone which indicator was the best, and couldn’t be bothered to predict whether the market would rise or fall tomorrow. But my own trading records started to become clearer: why I entered, what went wrong, when I exited, and how it turned out.

That’s when I realized that the real difficulty in trading isn’t that the market is too complicated. It’s that people always want to cram every complicated thing into their heads, then imagine that this will help them make fewer mistakes. In reality, the opposite is often true. The more scattered your knowledge, the easier it is to find excuses for yourself when placing a trade. 交易里有一种亏损特别容易被忽略。

每天刷盘、看文章、研究指标，收藏夹越来越满。别人讲突破，你研究突破；别人讲趋势，你研究趋势；有人靠短线赚钱，你又开始琢磨短线。回到自己的交易记录，还是那几种错误：追进去、拿不住、亏了想扛，赚了一点又提前跑。

我后来翻自己的历史记录，发现一个很有意思的东西。
真正让我亏大的是我自以为已经研究明白的行情。因为觉得自己懂，所以仓位敢放大；因为前面几次判断对了，所以这次也敢提前下注。
学得越多，胆子有时候反而越大。后来我开始反过来做。遇到一个新方法，不急着拿真钱试。先放进观察表，看它连续出现几十次，自己到底能不能看懂。看不懂的，不碰。解释不清楚为什么进场的，不碰。必须临时找指标给自己壮胆的，也不碰。这样下来，我反而没以前那么专业了。不会天天跟别人讨论哪个指标最牛，也懒得预测明天涨还是跌。但我自己的交易记录开始变得清楚：为什么进，错在哪里，什么时候走，最后结果怎么样。

这时候才发现，交易真正麻烦的地方，不是市场太复杂。是人总想把复杂的东西全部装进自己的脑子里，然后幻想这样就能少犯错。实际上很多时候恰恰相反。你知道得越杂，下单时越容易给自己找理由。真正有用的知识，不是让你每一段行情都敢做，而是让你知道这一段行情为什么可以不做@Square-Creator-58b326784 #ETH

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | The Market Sentiment Cycle: A Six-Act Play from Doubt to Euphoria
translatedData.subTitle:
The script is almost the same in every market cycle:
① Doubt: Prices rise for a few days, but no one believes it. Everyone is shouting, “It’s just a dead-cat bounce—sell!”
② Acceptance: Prices hit a new high, analysts turn bullish, and retail investors cautiously dip their toes in.
③ Excitement: Prices keep surging, people in the group start showing off their gains, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria: Everyone on social media is talking about crypto, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage is soaring.
⑤ Denial: Prices start falling, and everyone says it’s a “healthy correction and a chance to get in.”
⑥ Panic: Prices plunge repeatedly, and everyone is panic-selling—but this is where the seeds of the next cycle are planted.

Some lessons only make sense after you’ve taken a loss.

There’s a principle in market-maker thinking:
People are always saying, “The market maker is shaking out the weak hands.” But the real question is: If you were the market maker, how would you deal with the people currently in the market? Look at it from the other side’s perspective, and a lot of price action starts to make sense.

Take today’s $ETH  as an example: it’s now at 2,587, down 4.79% over 24 hours. This market action perfectly illustrates the principle above. It’s no coincidence—it’s human nature repeating itself in the markets.

It sounds simple, but it can take a lot of costly lessons to put into practice.
When it’s time to wait, you have to wait.

#ETH #投资哲学 #交易心态 #Crypto

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Are a Blockchain’s Fuel Costs?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay Gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT—but who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring funds, trading, or running
contracts) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to have their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of Gas).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → Gas fees skyrocket. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they choose late-night hours or quiet market periods for on-chain operations. The same operation can cost half as much.

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

【情绪陷阱与资金流】恐惧贪婪指数连续两日突破70但比特币并未放量上涨，显示大量散户追高。对比SOL/BNB等山寨币暴涨200%更可见资金正从主流币向炒作热点转移。这更像是一次针对空头的技术性反杀，而非趋势反转。如果未来24小时BTC放量突破$66,500且站稳，这个判断才有修正空间。

📝 深度矛盾点
【期权数据矛盾】BTC看跌期权未平仓量减少20%，但隐含波动率却从35%降至30%。这表明做市商认为短期内不会跌破$63K，但实际持仓者（通常是散户）却选择平仓而非继续押注下跌。这种散户情绪与专业机构的分歧可能预示着短期盘整将结束。

💡 结论
短期内BTC有15%概率突破$67K，前提是马斯克收购传闻能提振信心且鲸鱼持续加仓。但风险在于这个传闻只是诱饵——如果美联储宣布更激进加息，或者鲸鱼开始减仓，这个多头判断会立刻作废。建议小仓位试多，但设置$63,500止损，跌破就放弃幻想。

BitMine’s staking position depends on liquidity｜The 12,500 ETH transfer is not a new disclosure yet｜ETH down nearly 4%—I’m staying defensive

My stance is to wait and see. I won’t buy ETH against the downtrend just because of headlines saying “institutions are still buying.” BitMine’s October 5 press release filed with the U.S. SEC states that, as of 6:30 p.m. Eastern Time on October 4, the company held 6,016,414 ETH, equivalent to about 4.9% of the circulating supply it cited; 5,067,309 ETH of that total had been staked, or about 84% of its ETH holdings. This is an official disclosure with a clearly stated reporting cutoff, not a real-time update of its on-chain balance. The release also lists a 2.63% annualized staking yield over the past seven days—an observed rate, not a guaranteed future return. Binance News mentioned a transfer of 12,500 ETH from BitGo today, but until the company confirms it in a subsequent announcement or SEC filing, I won’t describe it as BitMine having “acquired another 12,500 ETH,” let alone add it to the officially disclosed holdings above.

The market impact of this is about more than just the amount purchased. When a company stakes a large treasury of ETH, some of its holdings are used for validation and to earn yield, which may affect the short-term supply of freely tradable tokens and the institution’s cost of holding them. But staking does not mean assets are locked up permanently: unstaking, liquidity arrangements, corporate financing needs, and pressure on the company’s stock price may all influence what happens next. Investors should also distinguish among “transfers between custodial addresses,” “changes in beneficial ownership,” and “confirmation in company financial disclosures.” Meanwhile, ETF flows and spot trading on exchanges are separate channels; not every movement between addresses should be interpreted as one company stepping in to support the market. At the time of writing, ETH/USDT on Binance was around $2,598, down about 3.92% over 24 hours, with a range of approximately $2,592–$2,725, below the 24-hour opening price of $2,704. The actual price action at least shows that publicly disclosed institutional holdings have not prevented the current pullback.

I see around $2,590 as an area to watch for a short-term low, with $2,625 as the first level ETH needs to reclaim. $2,660 and $2,700 are overhead resistance levels to contend with if it rebounds. If the price just oscillates around $2,600, neither trading volume nor direction would be enough to conclude that “institutional buying has caught the fall.” If it breaks below $2,585 and fails to recover quickly, I’ll abandon the short-term rebound thesis. Conversely, if the company later officially discloses a change in its holdings and ETH reclaims and holds above $2,700, then there would be grounds to raise my assessment of institutional demand—instead of treating rumors as facts in advance.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t try to catch the falling knife or use high leverage. Only if the price moves back above $2,625 and holds on a retest, with no new exchange security or deposit/withdrawal issues, would I use at most 3% of my total capital to try a spot long. The first target is $2,660, where I’d sell half; I’d hold the rest for $2,700. If the price falls below $2,585 after entry, I’d stop out and close the position immediately. If it reaches $2,660 and then falls back below $2,625, I’d close the remaining position too. If the entry conditions aren’t met, my actual position is zero—I won’t write about a plan as if it were already executed. The market can keep telling institutional-buying stories, but my account only responds to verifiable facts and predetermined exit levels.

#ETH
The above is my personal market observation only and does not constitute investment advice.

BitMine质押仓位要看流动性｜12,500枚转账尚非新披露｜ETH跌近4%我先防守

我的态度是观望，不因为“机构还在买”的标题就逆着下跌去接ETH。BitMine提交给美国SEC的10月5日公司新闻稿写明：截至美国东部时间10月4日18时30分，公司持有6,016,414枚ETH，约占其引用的流通供应量4.9%；其中5,067,309枚已参与质押，约为所持ETH的84%。这是有明确统计截点的正式披露，不等于此刻链上余额实时更新。稿件还列出其近七日年化质押收益率2.63%，那是观察值而非未来保底回报。今天币安新闻提到一笔从BitGo来的12,500枚ETH转移，但在公司下一份公告或SEC文件确认前，我不会把它直接写成BitMine“又已增持12,500枚”，更不会把它加到上述正式持仓数里。

这件事影响市场的机制不只是买入量。大额公司库存被质押，意味着部分ETH用于验证和获取收益，可能改变短期可流通筹码与机构持有成本；但质押不等于永久锁仓，退出、流动性安排、公司融资及股价压力仍可能影响后续行为。投资者还要区分“托管地址转账”“实际所有权变化”和“公司财报确认”三个层次。与此同时，ETF申赎与交易所现货是其他渠道，不能把所有地址流动都解释为一家公司在托底。写稿时币安ETH/USDT约2598美元，24小时跌约3.92%，区间约2592至2725，低于24小时开盘2704；真实价格反应至少表明，已公开的机构持仓并未阻止眼前回撤。

我看2590附近为短线低位观察区，2625为第一道收复门槛，2660和2700是反弹时需要面对的上方压力。若价格只在2600上下反复，成交和方向都不足以支持“机构买盘已经接住”的结论；若失守2585且不能迅速收回，我会把短线反弹假设作废。反过来，若后续公司正式披露新的持仓变化，再结合ETH重新站稳2700，才有理由上调对机构需求的判断，而不是先把传闻当事实。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与抄底，不做高杠杆。只有价格重新站上2625并回踩守住，同时没有新的交易所安全或充提异常，我才用总资金最多3%做现货试多。第一目标2660，触及减半；剩余仓位看2700。若入场后跌破2585，立即止损并平仓；若到了2660后再跌回2625，也平掉余仓。若没有触发入场条件，我的实际仓位就是零，不把计划写成已经成交。市场可以继续讲机构故事，但账户只接受可验证的事实与预设的退出线。

#ETH

translatedData.content:
【One number kept me staring for a long time】

Kalshi’s gold market surpassed Ethereum in contract volume just weeks after launching.

I’m not kidding. In September, gold had 54.2 billion in contracts, while ETH had just 31.8 billion. Fee revenue showed the same pattern: $5 million versus $2.6 million. I’ve seen traditional finance make inroads into crypto many times, but this kind of overwhelming difference in scale still made me stop and think.

Some context first: I’m not someone who gets excited just by looking at data. But what makes this comparison interesting is that it’s not BTC versus ETH. It’s gold—a store of value humanity has relied on for 5,000 years—outshining Ethereum’s use cases in the crypto derivatives market.

It’s true that ETH has fallen nearly 50% from its peak. But what concerns me more is the signal from the application layer. Abstract just announced it will shut down in December, and Blast previously said it was done, too. Two L2s called it quits in a single week, after burning through real money—Igloo spent tens of millions of dollars, then simply walked away. This isn’t a project failure; it’s a problem with the ecosystem.

I’m not saying ETH is going to zero. People who work in tech are like that: when they see a problem, their first thought is whether they can solve it. The Glamsterdam upgrade is running on testnet, and the approach to improving efficiency is sound. But getting the technology to work and making the business work are two different things. What does the mass retreat of L2s tell us? That at this price level and in this competitive landscape, the Layer 2 narrative alone isn’t enough anymore. It needs to be backed by real demand, not just sustained by fundraising and spending.

So where does that leave us? Market sentiment is still hovering in greedy territory, while prices are starting to pull back. I haven’t fully figured out this contradiction either. Are institutions selling or positioning themselves? Could regulators bring a new catalyst? I don’t have answers to any of that. But one thing is certain: ETH’s application-layer story is being reassessed. Projects that can deliver will survive; those relying purely on hype will be washed out.

What are you watching right now? Have you formed a new view on ETH’s fundamentals, or are you looking at other opportunities?

#ETH #加密分析 #QTC #Market Insights

content:
【有个数字让我盯了很久】

卡尔斯基的黄金市场，上线几周，合约量就超过了以太坊。

不是开玩笑。九月黄金542亿合约，ETH才318亿。费用收入也是，五百万对两百六十万。这速度，传统金融渗透加密市场，我见过多次，但这种量级的碾压，还是让我想了一下。

先说背景，我不是那种看到数据就亢奋的人。但这个对比有意思的地方在于：它不是BTC打ETH，是黄金——人类用了五千年的价值存储——在加密衍生品市场里，直接把以太坊的应用场景比下去了。

ETH从峰值跌了快一半，这是事实。但更让我在意的是应用层的信号。Abstract刚宣布十二月关闭，Blast之前也说不想玩了。一周内两个L2说再见，背后是实实在在的烧钱——Igloo烧了几千万刀，说不玩就不玩了。这不是项目失败，这是生态出问题了。

我不是说ETH会归零。搞技术的人都这样，看到问题第一反应是能不能解决。Glamsterdam升级在测试网跑起来了，效率提升的路子是对的。但技术跑通和商业跑通是两码事。L2们集体撤退说明什么？说明在这个价格区间、在这个竞争格局下，单纯的Layer2叙事已经不够了。得有真正的需求撑着，不是靠融资烧钱撑。

现在卡在哪儿呢？市场情绪还在贪婪区晃悠，但价格开始回调。这组矛盾我也没完全想明白。机构到底是在出货还是在布局？监管那边会不会有新的催化剂？这些我都没有答案。但有一点是确定的：ETH的应用层故事正在被重新检验，能落地的会留下来，纯靠概念的会被洗出去。

你现在在盯什么？是对ETH的基本面有新判断，还是在看别的机会？

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Flat Is a Position—and the One Experienced Traders Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and volatility wear down their capital.

In reality, staying flat is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t read the market, stay flat,
Stay flat when bulls and bears are battling it out, and after a string of losing trades—what you save in those three moments
is more than most people make from trading.

You may be tired of the hunting analogy, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. Keep your capital on hand, and you’ll have bullets when opportunity comes. Hold on to your bullets.

Ethereum: “backups” are no longer needed—they’ll have to find a new job

Imagine a busy road that’s constantly jammed with traffic. About five years ago, someone came up with a solution: build a bunch of detours alongside it—L2s, in other words. The idea was to ease the load on the main road. Each “detour” was billed as something like a branch of Ethereum, with its own logo.

But things didn’t go according to plan:

The main road unexpectedly got wider. Ethereum became faster than anyone expected.
The detours turned out to be less reliable than hoped. Many are still controlled by a small group of people, rather than by their communities.

Ethereum creator Vitalik Buterin said something along these lines: “Guys, the old model doesn’t work anymore. Just being a cheaper copy isn’t enough. If you want to survive, come up with something that makes you special.”

What this means for L2s:

Become truly decentralized, or you won’t earn people’s trust.
Find your own niche: privacy, identity verification, lightning-fast speed.

In other words, L2s aren’t being buried—they’re being sent back to retake the exam. The era of “just a cheaper copy” is ending, and the era of “so, what can you do?” is beginning.

$龙虾  A ten-year veteran of crypto futures, I became mute—and a collector of blacklists.

That March 12, I told a friend to buy the dip at #ETH . He thought it was too slow and went all-in on altcoins. When they went to zero, he blamed me for not stopping him.

During the 2021 bull market, a former colleague asked me for a surefire way to make money. I sent her an 8,000-word analysis. She thought it was too long, went all-in on SHIB with leverage, and got liquidated in a sudden wick. Then her husband yelled at her for being led astray by a colleague.

The one that hurt most was my protégé. He followed my advice and grew 1,800 U into 7,200 U by compounding with 1% positions. On day 33, he thought he’d figured it all out, went all-in on LUNA 2.0, got liquidated, and came to me asking for seed money.

After that, I learned to swallow my tongue.

Someone shows off a 300% gain—I like the post. Someone loses 90%—I light a candle. Someone asks for a price target—I reply, “Fortune-telling: ten yuan a session.”

Whenever I’m up 10%, I withdraw it immediately and buy rice and cooking oil. If I’m down 3%, I shut everything off automatically.

The crypto graveyard is open 24/7. Lock away the inside information, the screenshots of wealth, and the hand that twists the knife—and what’s left are the living.

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | The Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Exactly as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every bit of wisdom, so I wrote these down and stuck them up:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before opening a position. If you can’t, don’t open one.
2. Don’t let any single trade lose more than 2% of your capital. No exceptions.
3. Don’t add to losing positions. Never average down.
4. After three losing trades in a row, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. The money goes out; the peace of mind stays.

That’s all five. Not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they read the market wrong—it’s that their execution went off track. Let’s keep each other accountable.

#ETH

ETH spot ETFs see about $202 million in net outflows in a single day｜Concentrated in ETHA, not a broad-based retreat｜I’ll wait for funds and price action to align around 2,616

My stance is cautiously bearish, but I wouldn’t translate a single flow table directly into “Ethereum’s fundamentals are deteriorating.” As of around 4 p.m. Beijing time on October 7, Farside’s summary of U.S. spot ETH ETF flows showed net outflows of $50.8 million on October 5 and $201.9 million on October 6. Almost all of the outflows disclosed for the latter day came from BlackRock’s ETHA. Binance News also reported outflows of about $202 million, corroborating the figure and direction shown by Farside. These figures reflect net changes in fund share creations and redemptions; they do not mean that “BlackRock sold its own ETH,” nor do they prove that every institution is pulling out. The U.S. stock market has not yet closed on October 7, so today’s ETF net flows cannot be treated as final in advance.

This event is worth watching because ETFs transmit traditional investors’ demand for ETH directly to fund market makers and spot hedging activity. Sustained outflows can weaken marginal buying during a rebound, especially when prices are already weak; any bounce then needs confirmation from genuine trading volume. But redemptions, spot trading and price do not form a mechanical chain of cause and effect: liquidations of ETH leverage, dollar liquidity and BTC’s direction can also affect the market at the same time. At the time of writing, ETHUSDT on Binance was around $2,616, down about 3.66% over the past 24 hours, with a high of $2,725 and a low of $2,592. That is the reaction observed so far; I would not attribute the entire decline to ETFs. The 2,600–2,592 area is the immediate support zone. First, we’ll see whether price can reclaim 2,645–2,660. The 2,725 level is a more distant reference for resistance, not a guaranteed target.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase a short position or blindly buy above 2,600. I would consider a small spot long only if price regained and held above 2,660, then successfully retested it, and the next complete set of ETF data did not show continued significant outflows. My first entry would be no more than 5% of total capital, with no leverage. I’d initially target 2,695 and take half off there, while watching 2,725 with the remainder. After entry, I’d stop out if price fell back below 2,635. If price reached 2,695 but could not hold there for two hours, I’d proactively close the rest. Conversely, if 2,592 were decisively broken and a rebound failed at 2,600, I would only observe; I would not treat the breakdown as an immediate instruction to go short. If fund inflows return and ETH reclaims 2,660 on rising volume, I should abandon my current cautiously bearish view. Fund flows are one piece of evidence; trading discipline is the final line of defense.

#ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度是谨慎偏空，但不把一张资金表直接翻译成“以太坊基本面坏了”。截至10月7日北京时间16时许，Farside的美国现货ETH ETF汇总表显示：10月5日全市场净流出5080万美元，10月6日净流出2.019亿美元；后一天披露的流出几乎全部来自贝莱德ETHA。币安广场Binance News也报出约2.02亿美元，数值方向与Farside相互印证。这里说的是基金份额对应的申赎净变化，不是“贝莱德出售了自有ETH”，更不能据此断言每个机构都在撤离。10月7日美股尚未结束，今天的ETF净流量也不能提前写成已定稿。

这个事件值得看，是因为ETF把传统资金对ETH的需求直接传给基金做市与现货对冲环节。连续流出会削弱反弹时的边际买盘，尤其在价格已经偏弱时，任何回抽都更需要真实成交量确认。但申赎、现货成交和价格不是一条机械的因果链：ETH自身的杠杆清算、美元流动性和BTC方向也会同时影响盘面。写稿时币安ETHUSDT约2616美元，过去24小时约跌3.66%，区间高2725、低2592；这是已经观察到的反应，不把下跌全归因于ETF。2600至2592是眼前防守带，2645至2660先看能否收复，2725则是更远的压力参考，不是保证会到的目标。

如果是我自己交易，我目前不参与追空，也不在2600上方盲目接多。只有价格重新站稳2660、回踩不破，且下一次完整ETF数据没有继续显著流出，我才考虑现货试多，首笔不超过总资金的5%，不加杠杆；目标先看2695，到了先减半，余仓看2725。入场后若跌回2635下方止损，若冲到2695后两小时内无法维持，则主动平掉余仓。反过来，若2592被有效跌破且反抽2600失败，我只观察，不把下破当成立刻开空的命令；若基金净流入恢复、ETH放量收复2660，当前谨慎偏空判断就应撤销。资金流是证据之一，交易纪律才是最后一道闸门。

translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days in a year means a 12-fold return; earning a steady 10% a month,
means a 30-fold return over three years. It may not sound exciting, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market moves; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities must be waited for; discipline is your own. Don’t make your goal
“doubling your money this week.” Make it “making no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given by the market,
while the ability behind the latter is yours. The market opens every day, but only those who preserve their capital get to keep playing.

From 500U to 100K: The strongest strategy. Compounding your account is by no means about going all-in with oversized positions and gambling on a huge win. It’s about steadily building returns through timing, position control, and disciplined execution, while keeping liquidation risk extremely low throughout. #ETH 

6 practical rules for execution:
Start with a position of no more than 50%: Put up only 200–300U on your first trade to test the waters. The primary goal is to avoid liquidation and keep the maximum drawdown below 20%. Protecting your capital comes first.

Only take high-conviction trades: Trade only assets with clear support and resistance, a well-defined trend, and a risk-reward ratio of at least 2:1. Make every trade count, and don’t waste your capital on low-quality entries.

Set your stop-loss in advance: Strictly limit losses on any single trade to 5%–7% of your total account balance. For a 1,000U account, the stop-loss on a single trade must never exceed 50–70U. Never change your stop-loss on the fly.

Take profits without getting greedy: Lock in 30–50 points on small swings and target 80–150 points in major moves. For a mid-term trade, require a risk-reward ratio of at least 3:1 before entering. Don’t try to sell at the absolute top.

Increase position size after reaching 3,000U: Once your account grows to 3,000U, increase each position to 800–1,000U, while keeping the risk per trade at 3%–5% of your account balance and the maximum drawdown below 15%.

Withdraw profits whenever your account doubles: When your account grows from 1,000U to 3,000U, proactively withdraw 500U in profits. This can help you stay composed even if the account later experiences a drawdown.

The underlying logic of compounding:
Prioritize survival when your account is small, gradually pick up the pace when it’s medium-sized, and focus on protecting profits when it’s large. Strictly stick to this approach for 30 consecutive days, and your account’s equity curve will provide clear positive feedback. Staying in the game is the only prerequisite for growing your account and coming out ahead.

A beginner’s warning:
The main reason many people fail at compounding is that they abandon the rules halfway through and go all-in with oversized positions. One extreme market move can wipe out all the gains from dozens of previous trades. Discipline is the key to making this strategy work. 6步实战执行规则 ：
起步仓位≤5成‌：第一单仅上200~300U探路，核心目标先做到“不爆仓、最大回撤不超20%”，把保命放在第一位。

只打高确定性单‌：只参与有明确支撑阻力、趋势清晰、盈亏比≥2:1的标的，做到打一单、活一单，不做无效开单消耗本金。

提前锁死止损‌：单次交易亏损严格控制在账户总资金的5%~7%，1000U账户单笔止损绝不超过50~70U，绝对不临场临时修改止损。

止盈不贪多‌：小波段锁定30~50点收益，大节奏吃80~150点行情，中线单必须满足盈亏比≥3:1才进场，不追求卖在绝对最高点。

3000U后提仓加速：账户滚到3000U后，单次开仓仓位提升至800~1000U，把单笔风险压到账户资金的3%~5%，最大回撤控制在15%以内。

滚仓底层逻辑 ：
小钱阶段优先保命，中钱阶段稳步提速，大钱阶段核心守利。只要能严格守住这套节奏连续执行30天，你的账户净值曲线会给出最直观的正向反馈，活着才是翻仓上岸的唯一前提。

subTitle:
看对方向，也可能输给下单路径

今天午后这段盘面很典型：BTC 还在 8.4 万美元附近拉扯，ETH、SOL 也不是单边崩盘，但很多单子的体感已经变了。

价格看起来只是回了一点，真正变化的是下单那一刻的订单环境。

很多交易者复盘时只盯 K 线：这里是不是支撑，那里是不是突破，量能有没有放出来。但永续合约的真实结果，往往不是由截图里的那个价格决定，而是由你按下确认时吃到的报价层、深度、点差、费用和触发规则共同决定。

同样看对方向，最后成本可能完全不同。

第一层差异，是报价层。

盘面平稳时，买一卖一看起来很近，几档深度也够用。但行情一抖，挂单撤得比价格变化更快。你以为自己在接近图表价格的位置成交，实际吃到的是更外层的报价。单子越急，越容易把“看起来很小的点差”变成一笔真实成本。

第二层差异，是深度。

很多人只看最新成交价，却不看这个价格附近到底有多少可承接的量。表面上同一个交易对，同一根 K 线，不同路径的前几档深度可能完全不同。小单看不出来，大一点的单、或者波动放大的时刻，成交偏差就会突然明显。

第三层差异，是规则设计。

有些地方触发更敏感，有些地方报价更新更快，有些地方费用结构、标记价逻辑和风险缓冲不一样。方向判断没错，不代表订单会以你脑子里那个价格、那个节奏、那个成本完成。

这就是为什么我越来越不喜欢只说“看涨还是看跌”。

对交易者来说，方向只是第一步。真正影响体验的是：这笔单在什么订单环境里发生，它会穿过几层报价，触发后还有多少承接，成本会不会在成交之后才显形。

尤其在今天这种回撤不深、但情绪已经变谨慎的盘面里，碎片化流动性会被放大。不同路径之间的差别，不一定体现在首页价格上，而会体现在成交那一下、撤单那一下、触发那一下。

更麻烦的是，很多人只有在结果不舒服时才回头算账。

成交偏差高了，才发现刚才那边深度更薄；费用吃掉一截，才发现自己只看了方向；触发之后价格弹走，才发现风险缓冲不够。问题不是交易者不会分析图表，而是图表分析没有覆盖订单环境。

我觉得接下来合约交易里会越来越重要的一件事，是先把“路径比较”放到下单之前。

不是先忠诚于某个固定位置，也不是看到价格就急着执行，而是先比较不同 venue 的报价层、深度、费用、触发条件和成交偏差，再决定这一单往哪走。

PerpEX 这类执行比较视角的价值，正在这里变得清楚：它不是替你判断方向，而是提醒你，方向之外还有一层成本现实。市场给的是机会，订单环境决定你到底用什么价格拿到它。

今天这种盘面，最值得记住的不是“有没有跌破某个点”，而是：价格只动了一点，执行成本可能已经悄悄换了一层。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You Hold On to a Losing Position, Your Brain Is Fooling You
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on a trade focus on? The “all-time high,” thinking, “Once it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Pay attention: that thought is all attachment, no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to current supply and demand.

Once you’re stuck holding a position, you automatically collect good news and block out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You start thinking,
“This time is different.” Those five words have cost more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to follow: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
fails,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate decision-making from holding a position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

Adding to a losing position is a major trap for retail traders.#ETH 
I don’t know who came up with the term “adding to a position,” but it has trapped countless retail traders in crypto. Many people keep adding as their losses grow, only to get deeper and deeper into trouble. In the end, they burn through all their capital and drive themselves straight to liquidation. This is one of the most deadly bad habits in crypto trading.

The cardinal rule of trading: Never add to a position blindly when you’re losing. Instead, add to a winning position in the direction of the trend once profits confirm it.

Adding to a position in a downtrend is essentially doubling down on a bad decision. It only makes losses grow exponentially, turning what could have been a small loss into an unrecoverable pit.$牛来 

The right approach:
When the trend is going your way and your account is already showing unrealized profits, add to your position in the direction of the trend. This means using profits earned in the market to pursue a bigger move. You won’t risk your original capital, and you can amplify your returns—with much greater safety and a higher win rate.

Many traders have fallen into the trap of adding to losing positions along the way. If you’re feeling lost right now and can’t find a way forward, leave a comment. Traders on the same wavelength can come together and help each other avoid unnecessary detours.

Ethereum co-founder Vitalik offered a prediction at an industry summit in Asia: in the next two years, apps in the traditional sense may no longer exist on Ethereum.

His reasoning centers on the interface layer. Users will no longer open apps, connect wallets, and tap to confirm each step. They’ll simply say what they want, and agents will write scripts and carry out on-chain operations themselves. He gave his own example: updating an ENS record took five minutes, without him touching a single button or menu.

He also laid out the risks. To do their jobs, agents need to read users’ holdings, behavior, and risk preferences. For $ETH , on-chain activity is public by default, and the pseudonymous identity layer will be worn away once machine intermediaries get involved. Prompt injection can smuggle malicious instructions into data an agent reads. When an agent holds signing authority, a single mistake can have amplified consequences. Attacks on Ethereum’s user interaction layer caused roughly $1.4 billion in losses over the past year. The human layer has already proved to be a weak link, and replacing it with agents won’t automatically make things safer.

He ended with the old saying: “Not your keys, not your coins.” Going forward, we may need to add one more word: “Not your silicon, not your keys.”

#ETH #AI

Smart Money Concepts — From Zero to Advanced
Day 6: Fair Value Gaps & Imbalances

The market may leave wicks, but inefficiencies in price delivery leave their own footprint. Instead of placing random orders, track the zones where strong buying or selling pressure has created an imbalance. 🧵👇
 $BTC 
{spot}(BTCUSDT)

In SMC, Fair Value Gaps (FVGs) and imbalances are viewed as potential price inefficiencies. When aggressive buying or selling occurs in the market, price can move very quickly, leaving an untraded or inefficient area between candles.
 $ETH 
{spot}(ETHUSDT)

1. What is a Fair Value Gap (FVG)?
 
• 3-Candle Pattern:
An FVG is typically identified in the structure of 3 consecutive candles.
 
• Bullish FVG:
When the first candle’s high is below the third candle’s low, a price gap or inefficiency remains in between.
 
• Bearish FVG:
When the first candle’s low is above the third candle’s high, a bearish imbalance is created in between.
 $SOL 
{spot}(SOLUSDT)

• Mitigation / Rebalance:
Price may sometimes revisit these areas in the future. This is called mitigation or rebalancing—but remember, not every FVG gets filled.
 
2. How should you view FVGs in context?
 
Professional traders often evaluate FVGs in the broader market context rather than treating them as standalone signals:
 
• Confluence Zones:
When an FVG aligns with a valid Order Block, liquidity zone, market structure shift, or premium/discount area, it can become a stronger area of interest.
 
• Premium vs. Discount:
In a bullish structure, traders often focus on FVGs in discount areas, while FVGs in premium areas may be relevant in a bearish structure.
 
• Higher-Timeframe Context:
Rather than trading lower-timeframe FVGs blindly, it is also important to consider the higher-timeframe trend, liquidity, and key support/resistance zones.
